# Fixture asset licenses

`box.gltf` / `box.bin` and `box_textured.gltf` / `box_textured.bin` /
`box_textured_texture.png` are the "Box" and "Box Textured" sample models
from the [Khronos Group glTF-Sample-Models](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Models)
repository, donated by [Cesium](https://cesium.com/) for glTF testing and
licensed under a
[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

They are used here, unmodified except for the deliberately-broken copies
noted in `engine-assets`' test fixtures (which exist only to exercise
structured-error paths and are not redistributed model assets in their own
right).
